cases.script:
mkdir -p 'packages with spaces' empty
: > 'packages with spaces/bashclaude_old.pkg'
: > 'packages with spaces/bashclaude_new.pkg'
: > 'explicit ; literal.pkg'
/usr/bin/touch -d '2020-01-01' 'packages with spaces/bashclaude_old.pkg'
/usr/bin/touch -d '2025-01-01' 'packages with spaces/bashclaude_new.pkg'
unset BASHPKG_LOADABLES_DATADIR
BASHPKG_LOADABLES_DATADIR="$PWD/packages with spaces"
claude update 2>e1; r1=$?
claude update './explicit ; literal.pkg' 2>e2; r2=$?
BASHPKG_LOADABLES_DATADIR="$PWD/empty" claude update 2>e3; r3=$?
[[ $(<e1) == *"claude update: installing $PWD/packages with spaces/bashclaude_new.pkg"* ]] && echo newest=yes || echo newest=NO
[[ $(<e2) == *"claude update: installing ./explicit ; literal.pkg"* ]] && echo explicit=yes || echo explicit=NO
[[ $r1 != 0 && $r2 != 0 && $r3 == 1 && $(<e3) == *"no bashclaude_*.pkg found in $PWD/empty"* ]] && echo failures=yes || echo failures=NO
cases.oracle: Unexported and temporary shell variables select paths including spaces; metacharacters in an explicit filename are literal. Empty packages fail verification and an empty directory fails selection.
cases.comparison: Selection and failure behavior in the invoking shell.
